rationale: @pulp/react puts a controlled value control back to its committed value or checked prop after a handler rejects a discrete edit: the event trampoline records the delivered payload, the bridge's __dispatch__ prelude calls an after-dispatch hook once the outermost batch returns, and a new isWidgetParamBound query keeps parameter-bound widgets out of it. The checked prop now reaches the widget, and the bundle-size guard rises. Product bridge behaviour only: no design-import, capture, render-backend or proof authority moves.
tests: cd packages/pulp-react && npm run build && npx vitest run
cd packages/pulp-react && npx vitest run test/controlled-value-restore.test.ts
